name: Openclaw Bridge
description: `openclaw-bridge` is a Nextcloud **AppAPI ExApp** that turns OpenClaw into a real Nextcloud surface instead of a sidecar desktop process. The app shows up as a Nextcloud app, registers its own top-menu entry and file actions when enabled, and stores operator settings plus per-user preferences through Nextcloud/AppAPI i.
